heading, Want to build the futureof women’s health with us?, level 2
Want to build the futureof women’s health with us?
end of heading, Want to build the futureof women’s health with us?, level 2
We’re on a mission to solve real problems, and that starts with you.
Join us and turn your experiences and ideas into impactful solutions.
end of heading, What to expect?, level 2
Our goal is to make great products for women. That’s why we’re inviting you, as a user, to help us create products through our advisory board.
These sessions offer a chance to chat directly with our team about our products. Whether you’re head over heels or have a bone to pick, we want to hear it all.
Sometimes life moves too fast for calls, and that’s when these come in handy. We’ll shoot over surveys to gather your valuable insights on your own schedule.
end of heading, Meetups& Dinners, level 2
If you’re lucky enough to be in Stockholm, get ready for some real-world fun. Enjoy good food, great company, and share your thoughts on Hormona.
Be a part of building a better
